front: What was a nobleman in medieval Europe?
back: A man of high rank who held land.

front: About how long did the Middle Ages last?
back: About 1,000 years, from around 500 to 1500 AD.

front: Which empire faded away right before the Middle Ages began?
Which modern countries grew from lands that were once part of the western Roman Empire?
Why did local lords and church leaders become so powerful in the Middle Ages?
back: There was no strong central government after the western Roman Empire fell.

front: Where did most ordinary people live during the Middle Ages?
back: In small villages, working as farmers.

front: True or false: Everyone in the Middle Ages lived in a castle.
back: False. Only a few powerful families lived in castles. Most people lived in villages.

front: Why did people in medieval towns work hard to stay safe?
back: Raiders might attack and seize towns to take whatever they could carry.
